methods_quotes.q: Alcohol use was defined as a positive hospital laboratory result, and drug use was defined as a positive hospital or external toxicology result.
Among cases without toxicology testing, patients were considered to have used drugs or alcohol if such use was noted in the medical record.
Positive toxicology from drugs administered therapeutically was excluded from analysis.
